purpose: Private historical compatibility pilot, not a timing comparator
changes: Node local module imports and file-based verdict schema
Explicit current-jit mode requires both JIT exports; historical-interpreter requires both absent and records null missing instruction counter
Optional binary output emission for pilot frame hashing only; no timed browser measurement
Optional wall time cap without changing guest work or slice size
browserCompatibilityReason: Historical first-board builds predate esp32sim_set_jit and esp32sim_block_jit_insns. Browser adaptation must use the same explicit capability modes as this pilot: absence is accepted only for labeled historical interpreter execution; modern production JIT absence remains fatal. Missing counters must remain null, not invented zeros. Node file loading and binary-frame hashing are pilot-only and should not be included in browser timing.
previousVersion: harness-v1 unchanged; v2 adds final published LCD decoding
